title: Setback to an adjoining laneway or right-of-way that is the primary street
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a, adjoining laneway or right-of-way where it is the primary street to the dwelling (footnote 1: does not apply to ancillary dwellings): R10 and R12.5 As per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25 to R50-60 1.5m.

replaces.note: ROW as primary street 2 m -> 1.5 m (R30-R60, C4P1-077)
R10-R25 ROW treated as a secondary street; R10 3 m, R12.5 2 m, R15-R25 1.5 m unchanged

verified.note: 'As per Secondary Street setbacks' spans R10 and R12.5; 1.5m spans R15-25 to R50-60 (p29). Table 4A (p7) agrees.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.1#laneway-primary. R10-R12.5 as per secondary street, R15-R60 1.5 m (p29, p7). Table 3.3a footnote 1: this row does not apply to ancillary dwellings (applies_to is multiple_dwelling only).
